# VideoRecorderElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasVideoRecorderElement` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVideoRecorderElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVideoRecorderElement.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasVideoRecorderElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Video / audio capture

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasVideo](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasVideo.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasVideoRecorderElement> CreateVideoRecorder( const std::string& identifier, long x, long y, long w, long h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasVideoRecorderElement(const std::string& identifier = "VideoRecorder", long x = 0, long y = 0, long w = 640, long h = 420);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onRecordStarted` | `std::function<void()> onRecordStarted` | _Record started_ |
| `onRecordStopped` | `std::function<void()> onRecordStopped` | _Record stopped_ |
| `onSaved` | `std::function<void(const std::string& filePath)> onSaved` | _Saved_ |
| `onPermissionChanged` | `std::function<void(CameraPermission)> onPermissionChanged` | _Permission changed_ |
| `onError` | `std::function<void(const std::string& message)> onError` | _Error_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
